sentences.text:
Section 51 Of The Food Safety & Standards ... vs In Re: Amal
Patra @ Madan on 7 February, 2020
 1
07.02.2020

Sl. No.117 akd [Adjourned] C. R. M. 860 of 2020 In Re: An application for bail under Section 439 of
the Code of Criminal Procedure filed on 21.01.2020 in connection with Airport Police Station Case
No. 78 of 2018 dated 27.04.2018 under Sections 272/273/420/120B/34 of the Indian Penal Code
read with Section 51 of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006.

) And In
Re: Amal Patra @ Madan ... ... Petitioner Mr. Debangan Bhattacharjee .. Advocate Ms. Swarnali
Saha .. Advocate ... ... for the petitioner Mr. Neguive Ahmed .. Ld. Addl. Public Prosecutor Mrs.
Manasi Roy .. Advocate ... ... for the State
We are informed that date has been fixed for consideration of charge on 17th February, 2020.
Let this matter appear under the same heading on 24th February, 2020.
Trial court is directed to consider the issue of framing of charge in the meantime and report in that regard be filed on the next date of hearing.

(Suvra Ghosh, J.) (Joymalya Bagchi, J.)
